parameters.subject: = Reminder - Invoice #{{ $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.invoice_number }} - Due {{ $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.due_date }}
parameters.message:
={{ '

PAYMENT REMINDER

Invoice #' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.invoice_number + '

Hi ' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.client_name + ',

I hope you are doing well. This is a friendly reminder that the following invoice is due for payment.

Invoice#' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.invoice_number + '
Service' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.service + '
Amount Due' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.amount + '
Due Date' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.due_date + '

If you have already processed this payment please ignore this message. If you have any questions please reply to this email.

Thank you,
' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.freelancer_name + '

' }}

parameters.subject: =FINAL NOTICE - Invoice #{{ $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.invoice_number }} - Payment Required
parameters.message:
={{ '

FINAL NOTICE

Invoice #' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.invoice_number + '

Hi ' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.client_name + ',

This is a final notice regarding the following outstanding invoice. Immediate payment is required.

Invoice#' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.invoice_number + '
Service' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.service + '
Amount Due' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.amount + '
Original Due Date' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.due_date + '

Immediate payment is required to avoid further action on this account. If payment has already been sent, please disregard this notice, otherwise please respond today.

Regards,
' + $('Format Invoice Data').first().json.freelancer_name + '

' }}
